meta.name: understand-figma
meta.description: Analyze a Figma file via the Figma REST API and generate an interactive design knowledge graph (pages, screens, components, component sets, instances, design tokens) with a kind:"design" dashboard.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析 Figma 文件并生成交互式设计知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从 Figma 设计稿中提取结构化信息
copy.tagline_en: Analyze Figma files and generate an interactive design knowledge graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to extract structured information from Figma designs

howto.what: 它会分析你给出的 Figma 文件,生成一个交互式设计知识图谱(含页面、屏幕、组件、组件集、实例、设计令牌等),并自动启动 kind:"design" 仪表盘展示结果。需联网调用 Figma API。
howto.when: 当用户提供 Figma 文件 URL 或文件 key(可选带 --language 参数)时触发。使用前需设置 FIGMA_TOKEN 环境变量,否则会停止并提示。若文件无更新会报告已是最新。

say.text: 分析这个 Figma 文件:figma.com/file/abc123
say.note: 启动分析流程并生成知识图谱

say.text: 用中文分析这份 Figma 设计稿
分析这个 Figma 文件的最新版本
say.note: 检查更新并刷新知识图谱

howto.what_en: Analyzes a given Figma file and generates an interactive design knowledge graph (pages, screens, components, component sets, instances, design tokens), then auto-launches a kind:"design" dashboard. Requires network access to Figma API.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides a Figma file URL or key (optionally with --language). Requires FIGMA_TOKEN to be set first. Reports if graph is already up to date.

say_en.note: Starts analysis and builds the knowledge graph.

say_en.text: Analyze this Figma design in Chinese
say_en.note: Sets Chinese as the output language.

say_en.text: Analyze the latest version of this Figma file
say_en.note: Checks for updates and refreshes the graph.
